solution.title: Intune App Deployment Troubleshooting & Failure Remediation (Win32/LOB/Store)

products.name: Intune App Deployment Troubleshooting & Failure Remediation (Win32/LOB/Store) — Commercial
products.short_description: A root-cause method and scripts for Intune app-deployment failures (Win32/LOB/Store) — requirement, detection, dependency, download, exit-code, and ESP issues, with log triage. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Turn an Intune app-install failure into a known error code and fix

A Win32 app sits at “waiting for install status” or fails with a raw error code, and nobody knows if it's detection, requirements, a dependency, or the ESP. This toolkit gives you a root-cause method and scripts for Intune app deployment failures — Win32, LOB, and Store apps — decoding install/detection/requirement/dependency errors and reading the IntuneManagementExtension logs, so you fix the real cause fast.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the app-delivery pipeline (assign → requirement → download → install → detection → report), the ESP's role, and the model behind the diagnostic tree.
  • Requirements Guide — what you need (Intune roles, Graph read access, device log access) with how to verify each.
  • Diagnostic Playbook — a symptom tree (requirement not met, detection wrong, dependency/supersedence, download failure, exit-code decode, ESP block) with the exact checks per branch.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — app-assignment/readiness discovery, per-device install + detection validation, an app deployment coverage/failure report, safe re-attempt/cleanup remediation, and a target-group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with pass/fail gates (requirement met, installed, detected), plus Best Practices for detection rules and phased app rollout.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Every failed app install traced to its real cause — requirement, detection, dependency, or ESP — and fixed, with a repeatable method and scripts you keep and reuse.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • INTAPPDX-Discovery.ps1 — inventory Intune apps with their assignments, dependencies, and supersedence links
    • INTAPPDX-Remediation.ps1 — safely re-attempt a failed app install by forcing targeted device syncs (default -WhatIf)
    • INTAPPDX-Report.ps1 — produce an app deployment coverage and failure report across the fleet
    • INTAPPDX-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — add a pilot group assignment to an app for phased rollout (default -WhatIf)
    • INTAPPDX-Validation.ps1 — read per-device install and detection state for an app and map it to the pass/fail gates

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
